title: festuca cinerea subsp. psammophila
intro: Festuca cinerea subsp. psammophila, commonly known as the Sand Fescue, is a species of grass native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Festuca cinerea subsp. psammophila are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which have been shown to exhibit sedative, anxiolytic, and spasmolytic effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
